note: Interpretation rules the verdict layer applies in code to the Annex V elements whose requirement the Portaria conditions (D18). Default for an absent conditional element with no mandatory municipal slot: not_assessed, naming the condition. Entries here override the default and each says why. Proposed from the rule pack; not a legal opinion; the product owner decides product, not law.

V.27.g.why: «quando aplicável»: the taxa pela realização, manutenção e reforço de infraestruturas is due on every new building or enlargement (RJUE art. 116 + Celorico's taxas regulation); a prior communication for construção/ampliação is never exempt by its own facts, so the estimate is required. Celorico has no slot for it: the applicant files it under OUTDOC, recognised by its text.

V.15.why: «quando estas existam» qualifies the adjacent buildings, not the record itself: a photographic record of the existing situation of the plot is always possible and always asked for; Celorico marks FOTO optional, the law does not.

V.27.h.condition: whether an external entity must be consulted (servidões administrativas, restrições de utilidade pública, áreas classificadas) is not stated in the expediente

V.10.condition: whether any opinion, authorisation or approval unrelated to location is required depends on facts the expediente does not hold

V.27.i.ii.condition: «quando exigível, nos termos da lei»: the seismic reinforcement project depends on the building's class and date, not stated

V.27.i.iv.condition: «quando exigível, nos termos da lei»: whether the building needs a gas installation project is not stated

V.27.i.vii.condition: «quando exista logradouro privativo»: the expediente does not state whether there is a private yard to arrange

V.27.i.x.condition: electromechanical installations exist only when the project has lifts or similar equipment, not stated

V.27.i.xiii.condition: an HVAC project depends on the building's systems, not stated

V.27.i.xiv.condition: «quando exigível»: centralised technical management depends on the building's class and systems, not stated

V.27.a.why: «sempre que tal comprovação não resulte diretamente do n.º 5»: the certidão permanente (V.5, slot CRP) proves the right; the separate proof is needed only when it does not.

V.27.b.v.why: «caso se pretenda» propriedade horizontal: the applicant's choice, never missing.

V.27.c.i.condition: only when the operation cedes areas to the municipality, which the expediente does not state

V.27.c.ii.condition: only when the operation cedes areas to the municipality, which the expediente does not state

V.27.c.iii.condition: only when the operation cedes areas to the municipality, which the expediente does not state

V.27.d.condition: «quando exigível»: the seismic vulnerability report depends on the building's class and date, not stated

V.13.condition: only when the professional body cannot issue the code: the declaration of professional qualification replaces it

V.27.l.condition: only when the professional body cannot issue the code for the works director

V.27.q.condition: only when construction products without harmonised rules are used, which the expediente does not state

wording_core: observa as normas legais e regulamentares aplicáveis
wording_quote: observa as normas legais e regulamentares aplicáveis à pretensão
signer_rule: one certificate, one declarant: the certificate that signs the project authors' termos (V.11) belongs to their declarant; a termo of another declarant (coordinator V.12, works director V.27.k) signed with that same certificate is wrong_signer
site_pattern: localizad[ao] em (.+?)(?=, cuj[ao]|, observa|, com período|, declara|, freguesia|\. [A-ZÀ-Ú]|;|$)
